learn.title: A rule with inputs and outputs
learn.body: A relation is any set of pairs, like $(1,2)$ and $(3,6)$. The first number is the input and the second is the output. A function is a relation where each input has exactly one output.

learn.title: Is it a function?
steps: It is paired with 2 and also with 4
One input has two outputs, so this is not a function.

learn.title: Domain and range
learn.body: The domain is the set of all inputs. The range is the set of all outputs. For $\{(1,5),(2,7)\}$ the domain is $1,2$ and the range is $5,7$.

learn.title: Function notation
learn.body: The rule $f(x)=3x-2$ is read f of x. Putting in a number means replacing $x$ with it.
On a graph, a vertical line should never touch the curve twice. That is the vertical line test for a function.

questions.prompt: Which set of pairs is a function?
questions.explanation: In the first set every input appears once. In the others an input (1 or 0) is paired with two different outputs.

questions.prompt: In a function each input has exactly \_\_ output.
questions.explanation: That is the whole definition: one input, one output. Different inputs may share an output.
The domain is the set of inputs, the first numbers in each pair. The outputs 5, 7, 9 are the range.

questions.prompt: Match each word with its meaning.
questions.explanation: These three words describe any rule that turns inputs into outputs.
Solve $3x-2=13$: $3x=15$, so $x=5$. This is just a two-step equation.

questions.prompt: What does the vertical line test check?
choices: Every horizontal line meets the graph at most once
The graph passes through the origin
Every vertical line meets the graph at most once
questions.explanation: If a vertical line met the graph twice, one input would have two outputs, so it would not be a function.
